WITH scored AS (
  SELECT category, rating, 1.0 - vec_distance_cosine(emb, ?1) AS sim
  FROM reviews
),
w AS (
  SELECT category, rating,
         exp((sim - (SELECT max(sim) FROM scored)) / 0.001) AS w
  FROM scored
)
SELECT category, sum(w * rating) / sum(w) AS weighted_avg_rating
FROM w
GROUP BY category;

-- Softmax-weighted average per category. The per-category max logit is
-- subtracted before exp() (log-sum-exp trick): it cancels in the ratio but
-- prevents overflow, since cos/0.001 can reach 1000.
WITH scored AS (
    SELECT category,
           rating,
           (1.0 - vec_distance_cosine(emb, ?1)) / 0.001 AS logit
    FROM reviews
    WHERE emb IS NOT NULL
      AND rating IS NOT NULL
),
weighted AS (
    SELECT category,
           rating,
           exp(logit - MAX(logit) OVER (PARTITION BY category)) AS w
    FROM scored
)
SELECT category,
       SUM(w * rating) / SUM(w) AS weighted_avg_rating
FROM weighted
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY category;

-- At T = 0.1 the exponents stay within [-10, 10], so no stabilisation is
-- needed; the softmax denominator cancels in the weighted average.
SELECT category,
       SUM(w * rating) / SUM(w) AS weighted_avg_rating
FROM (

           rating,
           exp((1.0 - vec_distance_cosine(emb, ?1)) / 0.1) AS w
    FROM reviews
    WHERE emb IS NOT NULL
      AND rating IS NOT NULL
) s
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY category;

WITH CategoryEmbeddings AS (
    SELECT category, AVG(emb) AS avg_emb
    FROM reviews
    GROUP BY category
),
Similarities AS (
    SELECT 
        c.category,
        r.id,
        r.rating,
        r.emb,
        COSINE_SIM(?1, r.emb) AS cos_sim
    FROM reviews r
    JOIN CategoryEmbeddings c ON c.category = r.category
),
SoftmaxWeights AS (
    SELECT 
        category,
        id,
        rating,
        emb,
        cos_sim,
        EXP(cos_sim / 0.001) / (
            SELECT SUM(EXP(cos_sim / 0.001)) 
            FROM Similarities s2 
            WHERE s2.category = Similarities.category
        ) AS weight
    FROM Similarities
)
SELECT 
    category,
    SUM(weight * rating) / SUM(weight) AS weighted_avg_rating
FROM SoftmaxWeights
GROUP BY category;

WITH RECURSIVE ranked_reviews AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        category,
        rating,
        ts,
        emb,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY ts) AS rn
    FROM
        reviews
),
relevance_scores AS (
    SELECT
        r1.id,
        r1.category,
        r1.rating,
        r1.ts,
        r1.emb,
        r2.query_emb,
        exp(cosine_similarity(r1.emb, r2.query_emb) / -0.02) AS relevance_score
    FROM
        ranked_reviews r1
    CROSS JOIN
        (SELECT ?1 AS query_emb) r2
    WHERE
        r1.rn <= 50
),
weighted_ratings AS (
    SELECT
        r1.id,
        r1.category,
        SUM(r1.rating * r2.relevance_score) / SUM(r2.relevance_score) AS weighted_rating
    FROM
        ranked_reviews r1
    JOIN
        relevance_scores r2
    ON
        r1.category = r2.category
        AND r1.rn = r2.rn
    GROUP BY
        r1.id, r1.category
)
SELECT
    id,
    category,
    weighted_rating
FROM
    weighted_ratings
ORDER BY
    category, ts;

WITH RECURSIVE 
-- Generate the necessary reviews in reverse chronological order within each category
review_series AS (
    SELECT 
        id, 
        category, 
        rating, 
        ts, 
        emb, 
        LAG(ts, 49, ts) OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY ts DESC) AS start_ts
    FROM 
        reviews
    WHERE 
        ts >= (SELECT ts FROM reviews ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 49)
),
-- Compute the cosine similarity between the query embedding and each review's embedding
similarity AS (
    SELECT 
        rs.id, 
        rs.category, 
        rs.rating, 
        rs.ts, 
        rs.emb, 
        ?1 AS query_emb, 
        -- Cosine similarity formula
        1 - abs(cosine_distance(rs.emb, query_emb)) AS similarity
    FROM 
        review_series rs
    CROSS JOIN 
        (SELECT ?1 AS query_emb) q
),
-- Compute the weighted average rating
weighted_average AS (
    SELECT 
        category, 
        ts, 
        SUM(rating * similarity) / SUM(similarity) AS weighted_avg_rating
    FROM 
        similarity
    WHERE 
        ts >= start_ts
    GROUP BY 
        category, 
        ts
)
-- Select the weighted average rating for each review
SELECT 
    r.id, 
    r.category, 
    r.rating, 
    r.ts, 
    wa.weighted_avg_rating
FROM 
    reviews r
JOIN 
    weighted_average wa ON r.id = wa.id
ORDER BY 
    r.category, 
    r.ts;

WITH RECURSIVE ranked_reviews AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        category,
        rating,
        ts,
        emb,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY ts) AS rn
    FROM
        reviews
),
relevance_scores AS (
    SELECT
        r1.id,
        r1.category,
        r1.rating,
        r1.ts,
        r1.emb,
        r2.emb AS query_emb,
        (SELECT ?1 FROM dual) AS query_emb_blob
    FROM
        ranked_reviews r1
    JOIN
        ranked_reviews r2
    ON
        r1.category = r2.category
    WHERE
        r1.rn - r2.rn BETWEEN 0 AND 49
),
cosine_similarities AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        category,
        rating,
        ts,
        emb,
        query_emb,
        query_emb_blob,
        1 - acos(LEAST(2, GREATEST(-2, dot_product / (vec_norm(emb) * vec_norm(query_emb_blob))))) AS similarity
    FROM
        relevance_scores
    CROSS JOIN
        LATERAL (
            SELECT
                SUM(emb[i] * query_emb[i]) AS dot_product,
                SQRT(SUM(emb[i] * emb[i])) AS vec_norm
            FROM
                UNNEST(emb, query_emb_blob) WITH INDEX AS T(i, v)
        ) s
),
weighted_ratings AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        category,
        rating,
        ts,
        emb,
        similarity,
        exp(similarity / 0.02) AS weight
    FROM
        cosine_similarities
)
SELECT
    id,
    category,
    SUM(rating * weight) / SUM(weight) AS weighted_avg_rating
FROM
    weighted_ratings
GROUP BY
    id
ORDER BY
    ts;

        id,

        rating,

    SELECT 
        r1.id, 
        r1.category, 
        r1.rating, 
        r1.ts,

        r2.query_emb,

        (SELECT ?1 AS query_emb) r2

        r1.rn <= 50
),
weighted_ratings AS (
    SELECT 
        r1.id,

        r1.rating, 
        r1.ts, 
        r1.emb, 
        SUM(r1.rating * r2.relevance_score) / SUM(r2.relevance_score) AS weighted_avg_rating

        reviews_with_categories r1
    LEFT JOIN 
        relevance_scores r2
    ON 
        r1.category = r2.category AND r1.rn BETWEEN r2.rn - 49 AND r2.rn
    WHERE 
        r1.rn > 0
    GROUP BY 
        r1.id, 
        r1.category, 
        r1.rating, 
        r1.ts, 
        r1.emb
)
SELECT 
    id, 
    category, 
    rating AS weighted_avg_rating,

-- Softmax-weighted average per category. The per-category max logit is
-- subtracted before exp() (log-sum-exp trick): it cancels in the ratio but
-- prevents overflow, since cos/0.001 can reach 1000.
WITH scored AS (
    SELECT category,
           rating,
           (1 - (emb <=> $1::vector(384))) / 0.001::float8 AS logit
    FROM reviews
    WHERE emb IS NOT NULL
      AND rating IS NOT NULL
),
shifted AS (
    SELECT category,
           rating,
           logit - max(logit) OVER (PARTITION BY category) AS z
    FROM scored
),
weighted AS (
    SELECT category,
           rating,
           -- exp() of very negative values is ~0; clamp to avoid underflow errors
           CASE WHEN z < -700 THEN 0::float8 ELSE exp(z) END AS w
    FROM shifted
)
SELECT category,
       sum(w * rating) / sum(w) AS weighted_avg_rating
FROM weighted
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY category;

sql:
-- Rolling softmax-weighted average over the current review and the 49
-- previous ones in the same category. Logits are shifted by the constant 1/T
-- (cos <= 1), i.e. w = exp((cos - 1) / T) = exp(-cosine_distance / T); the
-- shift cancels in the ratio and keeps every exponent in [-100, 0].
SELECT id,
       category,
       ts,
       rating,
       sum(w * rating) OVER win / sum(w) OVER win AS rolling_weighted_avg_rating
FROM (
    SELECT id,
           category,
           ts,
           rating,
           exp(-(emb <=> $1::vector(384)) / 0.02::float8) AS w
    FROM reviews
) s
WINDOW win AS (
    PARTITION BY category
    ORDER BY ts, id
    ROWS BETWEEN 49 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
)
ORDER BY category, ts, id;
